notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
-Fixed bug where shovel would add game objects to inventory
-Fixed bug where using items with coconut would destroy them
-Removed "graphics update" heading

notes.title: The Graphics Update!
notes.notes:
The graphics for Lost Awakening have been updated to have a clean and crisp retro feel! Don't worry though: if you prefer the original graphics, you can change them back to the old graphics in the options menu. 

This patch includes:
[list]
[*] Completely updated graphics.
[*] Fixed a bug where click to use items with the shovel would cause the items to disappear.
[*] WAY more Persian rugs.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=AbOLhCxC1jQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Lost Awakening is Officially Released!
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone! 

I'm so excited to announce that Lost Awakening is, as of today, officially released and available for purchase! Thank you all so much for your support in the process of developing my first game. I have tested the game extensively, but we all know how games can play so differently from device to device; so please be sure to let me know if you find any bugs at all. Thanks again, and happy gaming!

~Simon Ward, from Hambug Games
